T.audio_profile: A tall, dry man of 30 with a low, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he never raises his voice.

dialogue_turns.text: [reading off her phone] Question. 'Do I need the language?'
[bright, to the camera] No! Just smile!
[to the camera, flat, counting] You need three words. Two. Please. Which gate.
[turning to him, triumphant] That's four words.
[flat, to her] Which gate is one word when you're late.

payload.scene: A phone vlog on the street outside an arena on game night, a crowd some way behind. A breeze.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.

text: Question. Do I need the language? No, just smile. You need three words. To, please, which gate? That's four words. Which gate is one word when you're late?
